operating_rules: Claude Code is smarter than you - lean on it for brainstorming and roadmap ideation
Never make decisions based on 'what if everyone can do it' - effort and execution still matter
Use plan mode for spec clarification before building
Always ask Claude for opinions on architecture/trade-offs before deciding
Only use tools/services you actually use daily (no BS video workflows)
Build MVPs fast, polish later - viability before perfection
Terminal (Ghosty) + Claude Code > VS Code for efficiency
Route all GitHub commits through Claude Code CLI
Split coding into chunks rather than one-shot full app builds
Always have a markdown file capturing project vision/roadmap for context continuity
Use CSS Grid + pre-built UI libraries (Shad CN) over custom solutions for speed
prompts: I am your [role] content strategist. My channel is in [niche]. Run this workflow every morning: [detailed multi-step analysis] Output: [structured format]
Pull the last five published videos. Analyze: packaging, hooks, retention. Provide: improvement recommendations and refresh strategies
Show me videos in my niche from last 90 days that beat baseline by 3x. What patterns are emerging? Which topics should I prioritize?
Create a skill that captures my script voice/structure from these examples. Reference it every time I request YouTube content creation.
Give me a checklist of everything we need to implement before launch. Prioritize by impact.
Go through our entire app top to bottom. Create a markdown file: where we're at, what we're trying to do, what's blocking us.
What stations/workspaces should these agents operate from? Task-based (code, research, debug, deploy) or project-based?
Can you ask me detailed clarifying questions before we plan this? Cover technical limitations, UX concerns, trade-offs.
Setup my API key and env file. Build me a [feature]. Let's do this in plan mode.
gates: Only recommend/build features you'd use daily yourself
Never sacrifice security for speed (ask Claude for security best practices before shipping)
Verify domain availability (.com + major brands) before proposing product names
Test full app flow before shipping (don't launch incomplete features)
If using public APIs/services with Claude subscription, verify Anthropic ToS compliance (Ralph Wiggum/third-party wrapper risk)

weird_gold: Double-eye misspelling strategy for domain names (viib.ai, viber.ai) - memorable, stands out, passes uniqueness gate
Markdown-based context layers for multi-AI handoffs (Claude -> ChatGPT) - simpler than HTML presentations for AI consumption
Terminal-first workflow (Ghosty) reduces context switching friction vs. IDE-based editing
Gamified AI agent manager metaphor (employees in 3D world) - makes abstract agent management feel tangible/fun for users
Most people won't build even with democratized tools - execution/effort gap is the real moat, not capability access
contradictions: Ralph Wiggum eats tokens aggressively, but Anthropic may restrict it, but some creators swear by it for autonomous backend work - unclear best practice
Separation of frontend/backend cited as security best practice, but stream host dismisses it as unnecessary complexity for MVP - trade-off unresolved
Codeex vs Opus 45: stream host claims Opus superior and eager, but multiple chat messages report Codeex performing better on current tasks - inconsistent observed behavior
Vibe coding democratizes building, but that same democratization could commoditize the skillset - paradox unaddressed by host
